description: The compatibility suite's ImpAI stage (tools/compat/tacompat.py, `wine --impai`), applied to the skirmish the stage seats on Town & Country: record 0 the human, record 1 a CORE computer seat played by the AI under test, record 2 an ARM computer seat OTA AI plays, Difficulty Hard. Every unit of the start is cleared, so the human seat has none, and each computer seat gets its commander back in a dry, flat box of its own about 5100 wu from the other's (heights 80 to 85 against the sea's 75; the boxes impai-handicap-economy.json's description measured), with the end test off so the human with no unit cannot end the level. After the stage's game time the suite derives the end from this file: every unit cleared but record 1's commander and the end test armed again, so the human seat's defeat ends the level and ImpAI's level-end lines are written. A mod whose sides are not ARM and CORE names its own stage in the setup's `scenarios` as `impai`.
